title: Ragdolls and death physics
player_outcome: Deaths look physical: humanoid enemies and the player crumple into ragdolls that tumble down slopes (short-lived, pooled), creatures without skeletons break into gore chunks (P3-20).
design: Godot PhysicalBone3D ragdolls for human-skeleton creatures (pooled, max N per preset, 3 s then fade), impulse from the killing hit direction; fallback to the P3-20 gore for others; budgeted.
Quality bar: what a AAA, realistic 3D Terraria made by Re-Logic would ship. Data-driven, performance-budgeted by graphics preset, Core logic tested, follows docs/overhaul/_BRIEF.md (LEAN MODE).
verification: creatures.cmds kills a zombie and probes fx.ragdolls
